$comment: Local-only configuration for the ingest pipeline. Everything is optional; defaults are used when a key is missing.
$downloader: URL import (youtube-dl / yt-dlp). proxy: '"auto"' health-checks what is configured or detected and uses the first live one, '"none"' forces a direct connection, anything else is used verbatim. outputDir: null = data/media, which the app treats as its own and may delete when a lesson is removed.
